_comment: Iron Brigade's choices over the generated layer (python -m rexnative adapt). The game drives a second device while loading: only Swap's is followed. CreateDevice (8263E748) is found but not hooked (the hand-made port did not hook it): the device is adopted from the first Swap. RunCommandBuffer (8264EF50) is hooked: the static scenery's G-buffer draws are in recorded command buffers it sends through INDIRECT_BUFFER packets no other hook sees; ReXNative replays them with cmdbuf 2, the default since it was tested in the first mission (1 only counts and logs them; 0 off). The buffers are re-recorded each pass (BeginCommandBuffer, draws, EndCommandBuffer, RunCommandBuffer, then handed back). 8264E720 and 8264EB30 are BeginCommandBuffer and EndCommandBuffer, never BeginTiling / EndTiling (game_layer.h lists them as candidates for those). Scene and defaults: the values the port ran with before ReXNative. enabled false: ReXNative is off by default here (the first 3D frames hang the GPU, docs/NATIVE_RENDERER.md); --rexnative=true turns it on.
